facts.text: Serve the blue milk at the Lars homestead breakfast table.
facts.why: Owen tells Luke to clean the droids before dinner, and the blue milk scene is the family meal that follows the same day. Nothing in the film puts the milk at breakfast.
facts.fix: Serve the blue milk at the Lars homestead dinner table.

facts.text: "I'll eat in the cockpit, thanks. Chewie gets the leftovers, and he always wants the leftovers."
facts.why: Han never says this. It is in quote marks and signed Han Solo, so it reads as a film line. A real Han line from the 1977 film is about hokey religions and blasters. I could not open a quote page for this film, so this fix is from memory.
facts.fix: Hokey religions and ancient weapons are no match for a good blaster at your side, kid.
